subject: QBR prep — runway triage & risk micro-playbook
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: QBR prep — runway triage & risk micro-playbook

Team,

Quick kickoff for the QBR section we'll present on product/eng launch readiness. I pulled together a short micro-playbook (attached) and a lightweight triage we should run over the next 48 hours. Goal: produce a 1-slide health summary + 3 mitigations per critical path for the QBR deck.

Asks (actionable, short):
- Karthik: update HW / infra blocker ETAs and call out any vendors we need procurement help on.
- Tessa: run the risk-drill (30m) tomorrow — propose agenda below and bring the latest per-team traffic-light snapshot.
- Laura: validate customer-facing canary windows and confirm any GTM shifts if launch moves 1–2 weeks.
- Vivek: I need a short callout (2 bullets) on scope prioritization and leadership escalation thresholds.

Attached: runway_micro-playbook_v1.pdf (living doc), traffic-light-snapshot.csv (current), canary-plan-notes.docx

Timing: aim to close all items by Tue EOD PT so we can freeze the QBR slide by Wed morning.

If any critical blockers are identified that risk the launch date, mark them as RED in the CSV and include an explicit rollback or fallback option.

Agenda (tomo risk-drill, 30m):
- 0–5m sync + confirm attendance
- 5–15m walk critical path owners and ETAs
- 15–25m decide mitigations + owners
- 25–30m confirm next steps + escalation points

Thanks — simple and pragmatic.

Irene Choi
Head of Product Ops | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

---
(attachment: runway_micro-playbook_v1.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep — runway triage & risk micro-playbook

On Sun, Jul 18, 2027 at 9:12 AM Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
> Quick kickoff for the QBR section...

Quick status from eng infra:
- HW procurement: 2 A100 racks delayed — vendor now estimating 10 business days (was 4). Impact: peak throughput for Dedicated pool reduced ~35% if we cannot get temporary burst nodes.
- Model quantization: Natasha finished POC for int8 but we need final perf validation on our staging infra (ETA: Tue EOD). If validation fails we lose ~18% cost improvement.
- Canary infra config: feature flags and fallback routing are ready; need to validate KV cache warmup strategy with a short synthetic run (1 hour) — I can schedule that Mon morning.

Blockers I need help with:
- Procurement escalation: vendor contact (CloudRacks) is only responding to account team. Can we escalate to procurement/sales to expedite shipment?
- Capacity plan: if racks slip, request to enable short-term GPU burst from Dedicated pool (policy + cost approval).

I'll populate the traffic-light CSV with the details and mark the HW item RED.

Karthik
VP, Serving Runtime
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

(attachment: traffic-light-snapshot.csv)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep — runway triage & risk micro-playbook

Morning — confirmed for the risk-drill call. Proposed slot: Mon 19 Jul 09:30–10:00 PT. Agenda follows Irene's outline; I will run a 15m focused triage on the HW/quant path and 10m on canary readiness.

Prep notes for the call (I put these in the drive link):
- Bring one mitigation per risk: (1) Short-term burst from Dedicated, (2) Narrowed feature scope for initial canary, (3) Canary gating with auto-fallback to smaller model variant.
- Decision rule: if any RED item lacks an owner + mitigation within 6 hours after the drill, escalate to leadership and include that as a 'scope trim candidate' for the QBR slide.

I'll send a calendar invite and include the external canary stakeholders where relevant.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Program Management

---
(quoted text omitted)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 12:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep — runway triage & risk micro-playbook

Thanks team — sharp and exactly the right framing. A couple of explicit leadership items:
- Freeze: institute a temporary freeze on non-essential UX polish and experimental routing changes for the next 2 weeks. Scope our QBR ask to a clear MVP baseline.
- Escalation threshold: anything RED that impacts customer GTM windows or increases cost >10% requires an immediate leadership brief.

Irene: for the slide please include these two bullets under 'Leadership asks' and note the cost delta ranges for each mitigation (Karthik to provide).

I will join the risk-drill for the final 10 minutes to confirm escalations and accept/decline any scope-trim recommendations. If we need to sign off on a procurement exception for burst, I'll approve on a case-by-case basis with cost estimate.

Vivek
CTO | Redwood Inference

(attachment: canary-plan-notes.docx)

From: John Park <john@nimblehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep — runway triage & risk micro-playbook

Irene / team — thanks for the visibility. Quick note from the customer side:
- NimbleHealth needs a firm canary week to coordinate internal comms. Our preference is the week of Aug 9, but we can be flexible up to Aug 16 if the team needs a two-week buffer.
- If there is a >1 week slip on the canary, we may ask for a short extension on our integration window (will confirm with our product ops).

Happy to join the canary prep call; please send an invite.

Best,
John Park
Sr Product Manager | NimbleHealth
john@nimblehealth.com
